title: FileChange
description: A file a tool call changes, and how. It is what the backend's undo snapshots and what turns on the diff of a row and of a pending request: the diff itself comes from `GET /sessions/:sessionId/tools/:toolUseId/diff`, never computed by the client, so the text being replaced never travels here (plan 28, D-28).

path.description: The file, absolute. A call that names a relative path has no change: it would resolve against the wrong folder.

op.description: `edit` changes part of the file, `write` replaces it whole or creates it, `delete` removes it, `move` renames it to `to`.

to.description: Where a `move` takes the file. Absent on every other operation.
